description: Angular component for an import dialog, handling file and JSON content import, with form validation, error handling, and UI logic.

classes.name: ImportDialogData
classes.description: Interface defining data passed to the import dialog component, including titles, labels, and optional flags.

classes.name: ImportDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing an import dialog with form controls, validation, and JSON parsing.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription for import type.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state, considering submission status.

methods.name: loadDataFromJsonContent
methods.description: Parses JSON content string into an object, with error notification on failure.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without returning data.

methods.name: importFromJson
methods.description: Handles import action, retrieves form data, and closes dialog with import data.

methods.name: importTypeChanged
methods.description: Enables/disables form controls based on selected import type.
